description: This file defines the `AdHocQueryDataValidator` class, which provides validation and parsing logic for ad hoc query parameters related to loans within the Fineract project. It checks JSON input for correctness, validates parameter values against expected formats and ranges, and extracts search conditions from the JSON data.

classes.name: AdHocQueryDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for ad hoc query parameters related to loan searches, responsible for validating input JSON and extracting search conditions.

methods.name: validateAdHocQueryParameters
methods.description: Validates the provided JSON string for correctness and consistency of ad hoc search parameters, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: retrieveSearchConditions
methods.description: Parses the JSON string after validation and extracts structured search conditions into an `AdHocQuerySearchConditions` object.

methods.name: extractLongValuesList
methods.description: Converts a list of string representations of numbers into a list of Long objects.
